change_summary: Preserve read-first and consent-before-write authority while keeping external handoffs weak, reconciling new evidence with the current Work Model, returning canonical topology readback, and retiring semantic Runtime fallback for duplicate roots.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill preserves silent bounded reads and user-owned write consent while adding current-Project discovery, dynamic Work Model reconciliation, and canonical topology readback.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.1 aligns consent and readiness behavior with weak topology handoff and canonical result consumption across adapters.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.41; archives retain transport constraints, WorkBuddy selective loading, provenance, trust, consent, readiness, and weak topology-reconciliation guidance.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Three-language guides explain user-owned read/write authority, Work Model compounding, event-versus-owner translation, current-Project discovery, and topology readback without exposing an internal recipe.

package_setup.note: Setup and the short SessionStart reminder preserve broad read activation without manufacturing write preference; canonical Skill projection carries the topology behavior.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history preserves read/write authority and makes dynamic topology a first-plan Reply/RunOps responsibility while retiring the conflicting semantic Runtime fallback.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.41 publication and hashes can be verified here; WorkBuddy Marketplace, Claude directory acceptance, and fresh independent-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover consent, readiness, first-plan ownership, and a 30-turn evaluator-only topology matrix; fresh Codex execution and Claude calibration remain explicit external evidence gates.
